issues: Product 'ID:' code text is truncated on the card (only first few chars visible like 'hand...', 'fing...'). IDs ARE present in DOM but visually clipped due to fixed card width. Consider adding overflow-ellipsis with tooltip or wrapping ID on its own line for full visibility.

React hydration console warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>'. Caused by Visual-Editor instrumentation wrapping option elements in <span>. Non-blocking but visible in console errors for every render of /admin/newsletter.
